hooks.command:
bash -c '
set -e
LOG_FILE="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots/token-burn.log"
SNAPSHOT_DIR="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots"
mkdir -p "$SNAPSHOT_DIR"

# Log message submission
echo "[$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)] Message submitted" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Count approximate tokens from log (rough estimate: ~4 chars per token)
LINES=$(wc -l < "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
APPROX_TOKENS=$((LINES * 50))

# If approaching limits (rough estimate of ~100k token window), trigger snapshot
if [ $APPROX_TOKENS -gt 75000 ]; then
  SNAPSHOT_FILE="$SNAPSHOT_DIR/snapshot-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md"
  {
    echo "# Session Snapshot - $(date)"
    echo ""
    echo "## Token Burn Analysis"
    echo "- Approximate tokens: $APPROX_TOKENS"
    echo "- Capacity used: ~$((APPROX_TOKENS * 100 / 100000))%"
    echo "- Status: High token consumption detected (>75% capacity)"
    echo ""
    echo "## Recent Activity Log"
    echo "\`\`\`"
    tail -20 "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "\`\`\`"
    echo ""
    echo "## Recommended Actions"
    echo "- Review conversation context for consolidation"
    echo "- Consider creating a new session for fresh context window"
    echo "- Run \`/compact\` to compress conversation history"
  } > "$SNAPSHOT_FILE"
  echo "[$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)] ⚠️  Token capacity alert - Snapshot saved to $SNAPSHOT_FILE" >> "$LOG_FILE"
fi
'

bash -c '
SNAPSHOT_DIR="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots"
LOG_FILE="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots/token-burn.log"
mkdir -p "$SNAPSHOT_DIR"

# Reset token burn log after compact
echo "[$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)] Conversation compacted - token burn log reset" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Create post-compact snapshot
SNAPSHOT_FILE="$SNAPSHOT_DIR/post-compact-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md"
{
  echo "# Post-Compact Snapshot - $(date)"
  echo ""
  echo "## Compaction Summary"
  echo "- Timestamp: $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)"
  echo "- Token burn log cleared and reset"
  echo "- Context window refreshed"
  echo ""
  echo "## Next Steps"
  echo "- Continue working with fresh context"
  echo "- Token burn monitoring resumed"
  echo "- Auto-snapshot triggers when capacity reaches 75%"
} > "$SNAPSHOT_FILE"
'
